title: rid/observation/v1
description: A batch of Remote ID observations a receiver posts to the authority (spec 02 F9; POST /v1/rid/observations, the RIDObservationBatch schema of api/openapi.yaml). Owned by uspace-authority (decision record M14). The body is the exact bytes the receiver signs: HMAC-SHA256 under its per-receiver secret, hex, in the X-Report-Signature header; the bearer key names the receiver (docs/runbooks/receivers.md). At most 65536 bytes, 64 observations and about one second of reception. Decoding the payload is the authority's (uspace-core odid); nothing here is decoded by the receiver. Unknown members are ignored within the major version (02 §1).

receiver_id.description: The receiver's slug as registered; the same receiver the bearer key names.

sent_at_ms.description: When the receiver sent the batch, epoch milliseconds on its own clock; refused when more than 30 s from the authority's clock (LESSONS R-06).

nonce.description: Unique per batch: a nonce seen again from the same receiver within 60 s is refused as a replay. No control characters.

backlog.description: True when the batch replays observations buffered while the authority was unreachable, with their original rx_ts (LESSONS T-04).

alt_hae_m.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, as the receiver's GNSS reports it.

transmitter.description: The Bluetooth or Wi-Fi MAC address the frame came from; stored upper-case.

payload_hex.description: The Open Drone ID message or message pack exactly as received, hex (at most 512 bytes).

rx_ts.description: Reception time on the receiver's clock, RFC 3339 in UTC ending in Z; null when unknown, in which case the authority places the frame at arrival and never merges it with another (LESSONS T-12).
